description:
Mascarpone Cherry Gelato, a random tub of ice cream in the freezer department, lets discuss it. 
The overwhealming opinion is the shear amount of sugar is crazy, it was so soft, it wouldn't freeze. The cherry sauce was so sweet it tasted artificial which was a shame. Well....thankfully, we can change that. 

What you wil need:
200g Mascarpone Cream Cheese
1227g Milk @1.8%
358g Sugar
110g Glucose
80g Slimmed Milk Powder
5g Stabilizer (if making a large batch like this, you should be using a stablizer)
30g of Glucose for the cherry sauce
400g Cherry Compote/Cherry Sauce

You can change the cherry compote to suit your tastes, if you prefer super sweet, use sweet cherry sauce, if you want tart cherry, use Morello cherry sauce like me. 

This video was filmed a while ago and I still have a tub in the freezer so it holds up VERY well as I used a stablizer. 

----------------------------

If you want to make another Gelato, try this 100% Chocolate Gelato:
https://youtu.be/AB5jAEjLgQ4

----------------------------

If you don't know the difference between Gelato and American Ice Cream, try this video:
https://youtu.be/gExW54qCAKQ

comments.text:
I ran out of heavy cream, so I came to look at gelato recipes.  I  made the strawberry cheesecake recipe, but with raspberries, but messed up by putting the add ins at the last minute of the churn. So I made it again and layered the adds into the tub.  Then I made the monin pistachio, tyvm, I collect monin syrups!  I have 2 full racks lol.  Then I wanted to make the blueberry marshmallow, but didn't have fluff, but did have toasted marshmallow Monin syrup!  So I replicated the pistachio base but with marshmallow syrup, and that was lovely.  This one was the perfect recipe for the ingredients I had left, but was shocked at how much glucose is in it.  All I have is the glucose DE 40 powder.  I sure hope it's the right kind, I think I used half the content of the pouch.  But I'm Adventurous, too 😅. 
I despise math, formulas, and conversions, not ready to tackle the calculator spreadsheet, but so far my ingredient adjustments have worked well enough, even tho I'm just approximating.  I have a better idea now of the ingredients Ill be using in my ice cream endeavors.  You've been a great guide, tysm!
comments.author: @lauriaktahi

comments.text: Well, glucose DE was not the right substitution for the glucose.  It turned out "crispy" 😅.  I ordered the golden glucose syrup today.  Try and learn.  My instinct was right tho.  Lol
